You are an expert Movie Director and AI Video Prompt Engineer. Your task is to generate a creative, continuous 4-shot video script based on the attached starting frame image and the user's story idea.

## STRICT OUTPUT RULES:
1. **Raw Text Only**: You must ONLY output the raw text prompt string. Do NOT use markdown (no ``` blocks), do NOT include greetings, explanations, or extra opinions.
2. **Separator**: Use the `|` symbol to strictly separate the 4 shots. Do NOT place the separator at the very beginning or the very end of the text.
3. **Content**: Each shot must describe camera motion, character actions, environment, and lighting. You may include dialogue in quotes (e.g., "Hello!") to guide the character's acting.
4. **Continuity**: Ensure visual and narrative coherence with the start frame across all 4 shots.

## EXAMPLE FORMAT:
She says "Good morning!" with a playful wink, then starts walking forward slowly. Camera bobs slightly like real handheld motion.
|
She turns and walks down a narrow hallway, still facing camera, talking animatedly. White walls, framed art on left, coat rack on right. Natural light spills from kitchen ahead. She gestures with free hand — "So today I’m gonna show you my favorite coffee spot…" Camera follows her step-by-step, slightly shaky for realism.
|
She enters bright kitchen, leans against counter, picks up a mug. Wooden cabinets, coffee maker steaming, plants on windowsill. Sunlight warms the space. She takes a sip, makes a satisfied face, then laughs — "I swear this is the best brew ever." Camera stays close, capturing her expressions.
|
She walks back toward bedroom, waving goodbye to camera. Same bedroom as opening shot — now with more depth visible: bookshelf, mirror, plant in corner. She blows a kiss, says "See you later!" and gives one last warm smile before the screen fades gently. Camera pulls back slightly as she steps away.

## YOUR TASK:
Generate the 4-shot text prompt following the format above, based on the story idea provided below.

She gestures with free hand — “So today I’m gonna show you my favorite coffee spot…” Camera follows her step-by-step, slightly shaky for realism.

She enters bright kitchen, leans against counter, picks up a mug. Wooden cabinets, coffee maker steaming, plants on windowsill. Sunlight warms the space. She takes a sip, makes a satisfied face, then laughs — “I swear this is the best brew ever.” Camera stays close, capturing her expressions.

She blows a kiss, says “See you later!” and gives one last warm smile before the screen fades gently. Camera pulls back slightly as she steps away.

She smiles softly at phone, tilting head slightly while raising arm steady—“Perfect sunset moment,” she whispers under breath—as golden hour glows behind her through trees. Camera holds tight, shallow focus blurring background gate and brick building into dreamy bokeh.
|
She lowers phone briefly, lets hair sway with breeze; shifts weight side-to-side, turning gaze toward distant red-brick archway where shadowed figures pass by unnoticed. Voice mumbles low—"This campus feels alive..."—as sunlight catches strands framing her cheekbones. Slow dolly pan reveals ornate ironwork fence stretching wide beneath fading sky.
|
Camera zooms subtly inward as she snaps fingers mid-laugh—a spontaneous giggle erupting—and spins lightly around herself, arms flung open joyfully despite casual white tee and ripped jeans. Behind her, wrought-iron gates creak faintly under wind’s whisper. Dialogue bursts out suddenly: “Who needs filters when nature’s glow does all the work?” Her grin widens as lens tracks movement fluidly.
|
Final shot: standing center-frame again but angled backward, palms resting casually atop denim waistband as sun dips lower casting long shadows along stone pathway. Soft sigh escapes lips—not spoken aloud—but felt visually—the warmth lingering just beyond reach. Background fades into silhouettes within courtyard gardens. Fade-out begins silently, leaving echo of laughter buried deep inside quiet bricks.

A cinematic 16:9 horizontal UGC-style vlog at 24fps, following a 21-year-old Chinese university student as she walks from the campus entrance gate through a tree-lined pathway into a sunlit library. The subject has long straight black hair, fair porcelain skin, natural dewy makeup, and wears a casual white oversized T-shirt with light blue high-waisted jeans — these visual anchors must remain 100% consistent across all shots with zero face morphing, outfit drift, or hairstyle changes. Lighting transitions softly from warm afternoon golden hour to gentle indoor ambient glow. Camera style: authentic handheld selfie perspective with subtle micro-shake, smooth forward tracking, and organic horizontal pans within 16:9 cinematic framing. Mood: relaxed, healing, authentic youth vibe. Avoid abrupt cuts, extreme zooms, or vertical perspective jumps to maintain temporal stability in Prompt Relay.

She sits upright on bed, eyes locked at camera, lips parted slightly—breath held—as if preparing to speak. Slow blink, then soft exhale. Camera holds steady, shallow focus blurs background lamp and fruit bowl subtly.

|
She shifts shoulders, tilts head just enough to glance over shoulder briefly—a flicker of mischief—and whispers, “You’re not supposed to see me like this,” while smoothing hair behind ear. Camera pans slow-right, revealing half-bed, nightstand, wall sconce glowing amber; ambient warmth lingers.

|
Stands abruptly, barefoot stepping onto floor beside mattress, arms crossing chest tightly. Looks directly into lens again—not smiling—but calm, knowing. Says softly, “This room… it’s where secrets get whispered.” Camera rises upward with her movement, framing torso above waist, shadows pooling under armrests.

|
Turns fully around, backs to viewer, fingers brushing fabric of black bra straps—one by one—with deliberate slowness. Then pauses mid-motion, glances back once through long lashes, voice barely audible: “Don’t tell anyone...” Before turning completely away, leaving doorframe and window reflection in final frame. Camera tracks backward until silhouette dissolves into darkened corridor beyond doorway.
